invariants_created: PASS must be sent after USER command for authentication
Data transfer commands (LIST, RETR, STOR, NLST, MLSD) require successful authentication before execution
PASV or PORT should be sent before data transfer commands to establish data connection
QUIT can be sent from any state to terminate session
After authentication failure (530 response), user may retry with USER command
RNTO must follow RNFR command for rename operations
Initial server greeting (220) is sent before any client commands
TYPE command should be sent before data transfer to set appropriate transfer mode
FEAT command is typically sent after authentication to discover server capabilities
USER.username: Must be a non-empty string identifying the user account
PASS.password: Must be provided after USER command; can be empty string for anonymous access
PORT.h1,h2,h3,h4,p1,p2: Six comma-separated integers representing IP address (h1-h4) and port number (p1*256+p2)
TYPE.type: Must be 'A' for ASCII or 'I' for Image/binary transfer mode
CWD.path: Must be a valid directory path on the server filesystem
RETR.filename: Must reference an existing readable file on the server
STOR.filename: Specifies target filename for upload; may overwrite existing file
RNFR.pathname: Must reference an existing file or directory to be renamed
RNTO.pathname: Specifies new name/path for the file; must not conflict with existing entries
MKD.pathname: Specifies new directory name; parent directory must exist
DELE.filename: Must reference an existing file that can be deleted
RMD.pathname: Must reference an existing empty directory
